reviews.title: Aesthetically pleasing and works well
reviews.comment: I got this for my son's PC build, it was super easy to install and had instructions that were easy to follow. It doesn't make any noise and has good airflow. I think the LED colors look so cool and the little screen can be customized with you personal image and layout preference. It was a good value for how much it was.

reviews.title: Does a great job cooling, easy to install and looks great!
reviews.comment: A great 360 all in one cooler. Just installed it on my Ryzen 7 7800x3d and its keeping it cool while looking sweet! The only thing I might do is paint the silver bracket black to match the motherboard. The software is a quick install giving the user numerous options for the display colors and readouts. The colors will be brighter when I remove the clear sticker that protects the fans and read out surfaces.

reviews.title: Great cooling product, LCD has issues.
reviews.comment:
As far as the Pump and fans go, this AIO is fantastic. Keeps my 14700k WELL within spec for temps, However the LCD screen has issues and so does Thermalright themselves, my LCD screen would not work with the provided cable nor a replacement I bought or 8 other USB-C Cables. I reached out to thermalright per Amazons request, and Thermalright basically said they wouldnt warranty anything and to just replace it on Amazon, which to be is bad practice. Amazon however did a wonderful job at correcting the issue by sending me a new AIO that had a great working LCD screen with provided cable.
All in all, this AIO cools very effectively, when the LCD screen works it looks great and the fans provided are quiet and work really well, I love being able to daisy chain the fans to reduce cables needing plugged in. I would recommend buying this AIO on amazon because at least Amazon will help replace it if it doesn't work perfectly. No issues with seller or amazon, solely on Thermalright for subpar customer service and USB-C connections on their LCD screen.
reviews.author: Jeff
